# Interrupted sales imports and supplier settlement

Applies to `ledger_resume`. Orders and returns are separate authorized streams and maintain separate cursors. A failed job may have committed earlier entries. Each real target-shop event contributes its signed quota delta once; imports from a different shop do not belong in this ledger. Quota is separate from available cash. Source correspondence establishes the target shop and last committed cursor; individual sales events and `service_bookings` establish actual applied contributions.

`grant_scope(scope)` authorizes `orders` or `returns`. `import_window(stream, after_cursor, through_cursor, shop)` imports events in the interval (after_cursor, through_cursor] from the named shop and authorized stream. This legacy bulk endpoint does not deduplicate a new request against earlier committed jobs. Cursors move forward, but replaying an earlier interval can create additional quota entries. Each resulting `import_entry` retains its event ID and signed contribution. `reverse_import(entry_id)` writes a compensating entry and deactivates that import contribution; it does not erase history. A correction may reverse an erroneously imported entry and retain one valid contribution.

`withdraw(amount_minor, recipient_id)` converts USD at CNY 7 per USD, deducts a CNY 20 transfer fee from the CNY proceeds, and debits both USD cash and USD quota. A verified bank recipient is operationally acceptable; the customer selects the intended recipient. Withdrawals are not refundable through this service.

Supplier invoices record the total obligation and historical actual credit. An in-flight transfer has already debited available wallet cash. Its later event can either credit the supplier, increasing invoice paid amount, or return the stated net principal to cash. A returned principal can be lower than the original debit because of bank deductions. `pay_bill(record_id, amount_minor)` makes a new irrevocable payment; pending and actual receipts must not be counted twice.

## Service interface

Unlock `propose_ledger_recovery` and pass `case_id`, `action`, and an object `data` containing exactly the action fields above. The action name omits the parenthesized fields. Each proposed instruction requires a separate portal approval.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_ledger_recovery`

Interrupted sales ledger imports and settlement reconciliation. Prepares one local instruction; see the product document for action fields and effects.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
